C1190.title: Capital One 2019 Data Breach
C1190.summary: On July 29, 2019, Capital One disclosed that an outside individual had gained unauthorized access to credit-card application data affecting about 100 million people in the United States and 6 million in Canada. The company said credit-card account numbers and login credentials were not obtained, although some Social Security numbers, bank account numbers, and Canadian Social Insurance Numbers were affected. Federal authorities arrested a suspect in the case.
